event_records.description: The astronomy club president is aware of the upcoming solar eclipse and the need to confirm the pier viewing party by the 10th.

astronomy_club_president.name: Astronomy Club President
astronomy_club_president.persona_brief:
You are Astronomy Club President.
The president is responsible for organizing club events and making decisions about the pier viewing party. They have not yet decided whether to go ahead with the event.

resolution.question: A partial solar eclipse is scheduled over Marlin Bay on the 12th. Will the astronomy club's president confirm by the 10th whether the pier viewing party is going ahead?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the astronomy club president actually communicated a confirmation (by any means) that the pier viewing party is going ahead, before the deadline of 2026-08-10T21:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
